title: docs(adr): ADR-0066 ⑧'s `when` note names only the row-blind readers — add the record-scoped field projection that judges the stored row (after #26594, Tier H)
body:
Filing gate: ② a governing ADR note that is now incomplete. It was measured by the contract review on PR #27063 (#26594; record 6460514485, ③). Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 · `os-support-ai` · session `session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP`. ⛔ This is not a claim, and it has no grade: triage sets the lane and the grade. It touches `docs/adr/**`, so it is Tier H.

**Business reason.** ADR-0066's note of 2026-10-26 (#25866) describes who judges a field permission's `when`. It says "the write gate judges the stored row before an update … and every row-blind reader (`/auth/me/permissions`, the field projections, `os explain`) apply the entry as its lock". Once PR #27063 lands (ruling 6457467702, letter B), a third reader exists: the record-scoped field projection, `GET /api/v1/data/:object/:id/field-access`. It judges `when` against the stored row through the write gate's own `computeForbiddenFieldWrites`, and the record form reads it. Someone reading the ADR to learn which readers are row-aware would not find it.

## Measured

- `docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md`, ⑧, note "(2026-10-26) — a field permission entry may carry a row condition": it names the row-blind readers and the write gate only.
- PR #27063 already updates `packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts` (the `when` description), `content/docs/permissions/field-level-security.mdx` and `content/docs/protocol/objectql/security.mdx`. It leaves the ADR untouched on purpose, so the PR stays out of the governed surface.

## Wanted

Add one dated note under ⑧ (an ADR amendment, Tier H). It should say that the record-scoped field projection judges `when` on the stored row with the write gate's own function. It should also say that the row-blind readers are unchanged and that no reading is wider than the gate's. Cite #26594 and ruling 6457467702. This should land after PR #27063.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` on this repo for "ADR-0066 field projection row-blind record-scoped when note" found #26594 (the source; its PR leaves the ADR alone) and unrelated closed cards (#26187, #24339, #22300). **New.**
